data.name: ENS
data.description: Decentralised naming for wallets, websites, & more.

methodology.Fees: ENS .eth name registration and renewal costs (base cost plus temporary premium) across every registrar controller since the 2019 launch.
methodology.Revenue: Same as fees: ENS keeps 100% of registration and renewal costs in the DAO treasury, so revenue equals fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as revenue: all fees accrue to the ENS DAO treasury. ENS token holders receive no direct fee distribution and there is no buyback.

Fees.Name registration fees: Cost paid to register .eth names across all ETHRegistrarController versions. The 2019-2020 controllers report a single combined cost; the 2023+ controllers report base cost plus temporary Dutch-auction premium, both counted in full.
Fees.Name renewal fees: Cost paid to renew .eth names across all ETHRegistrarController versions.
